content:
After being previewed at the May I/O 2026 conference, Gemini for macOS has officially launched an advanced voice control feature.

Google positions this feature as allowing users to "naturally converse in any window on desktop", and brings two main capabilities.

The first is "smart voice input", which can "transcribe spoken content into clean, appropriate text". Gemini will automatically remove filler words like "um" and "uh", and take into account mid-sentence corrections to accurately capture what the user wants to express.

The formatted text will be automatically inserted at the current cursor position, providing an experience similar to the Gboard Rambler keyboard's voice-to-text feature that will soon debut on Gemini Intelligence phones.

The other capability goes beyond simple transcription, understanding current on-screen content to perform complex tasks. This optional feature requires users to enable Gemini's reasoning function in the app settings.

  • Capture and organize information: mark local files, images, or documents on the desktop, then tell Gemini what you need. For example, you could say: "Read these veterinary records and email a summary of my dog's medical history to the boarding centre."
  • Write and rewrite text: mark text anywhere on the screen, then use voice to instantly rewrite, adjust the tone, and precisely place the revised version where needed. You could try saying: "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary and add a TL;DR at the beginning."
  • Generate and edit images: when brainstorming concepts or planning a trip, you can use voice to generate visual materials; or refer to existing designs on the desktop and request quick updates. You could try saying: "Based on this illustration, generate a dark mode version."

No matter where you are in macOS, long-press the Fn key to activate it, or click the newly added screen share button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" prompt. Gemini will display a floating capsule icon with a sound wave animation at the bottom of the screen.

Please make sure Gemini for macOS is updated to the latest version (1.88). This new voice feature is rolling out globally, currently supporting English, with more languages to come "later".
